title: Communal street or battleaxe leg minimum width 3.6 m
text: A communal street or battleaxe leg is to be a minimum width of 3.6m, inclusive of a minimum: i. 3m wide driveway in accordance with C3.7.3; and ii. 0.3m setback either side of the driveway (refer Figure 3.7g).

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Content twin of Chapter 2 C3.7.9 (battleaxe leg 3.6 m), renumbered and widened to a communal street or battleaxe leg; the fact is site.communal_street_width_m (communal street or battleaxe leg width) instead of site.battleaxe_leg_width_m. The text sets one width (3.6 m) regardless of dwelling count; C3.7.15 ('notwithstanding C3.7.13') sets 12 m where 20 or more lots take access, tested separately. The 3 m driveway is C3.7.3(i); the 0.3 m margins are C3.7.3(iii). Merit M3.7.3 allows a reduced width to retain an existing dwelling.
